Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

education — the process of learning at school. Example: My education was in Rome.
experience — time spent doing a job. Example: I have got five years of experience.
skill — something you can do well. Example: My skills are languages and numbers.
profile — a short description of a person. Example: This is my work profile.
work — to do a job. Example: I work in a bank.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have got a degree in ...
• I have got ... years of experience.
• My skills are ...
• I work in ...
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Present Simple for work routines.
Present a profile in three parts: education, experience and skills. Use the present simple and have got: I have got a degree. I work in a bank. My skills are languages and numbers.
